activities.name: Waking Nightmares

builds.name: Whirlwind Leveling
builds.playstyle: Spin through packs with Whirlwind while Rallying Cry funds your Fury. Lunging Strike closes gaps and refills Fury between packs.
rotation: Wrath of the Berserker for elites

gear.summary: Two-handed slashing weapon for bleed; stack Attack Speed and Fury generation.

1-15.tip: Put 1 point into Ground Stomp or Iron Skin by level 8 — a stun or barrier on a short cooldown is the difference between a smooth climb and a death loop.

15-70.breakpoint: Level 15 unlocks Arsenal expertise tracking — pick the Technique slot that matches your main weapon (two-handed slashing for Rend/Whirlwind bleed, bludgeoning for HotA).

builds.name: Whirlwind
builds.playstyle: The flagship Barbarian spin. Dust Devils and bleeds shred Pit floors while Challenging Shout and Rallying Cry keep you unkillable.
rotation: Wrath of the Berserker before the elite

gear.summary: Grandfather or Magnum Opus as the 2H slashing weapon; Harlequin Crest for cooldowns.

builds.name: Ancients / Bro'Barian
builds.playstyle: Summon the three Ancients as often as possible; your brothers do the work while you weave HotA slams and keep shouts rolling.
rotation: HotA slams while Ancients are up

gear.summary: Heavy CDR stack on helm/amulet/rings to keep the Ancients permanently summoned.

builds.name: Hammer of the Ancients
builds.playstyle: Huge single slams with an earthquake follow-up. Slower than Whirlwind but deletes bosses once Overpower lines up.

gear.summary: Two-handed bludgeoning weapon; Overpower and Fury cost on gloves.

builds.name: Flame Charge
builds.playstyle: The new S15 hellfire charge: dash through lines of enemies leaving burning trails. One of the fastest Helltide and Waking Nightmare farmers.

gear.summary: Cooldown reduction and Fire damage; Shroud for movement and resources.

builds.name: Rend
builds.playstyle: Stack bleeds with Rend and let Gushing Wounds explode them. Ramp-up heavy but strong in long Pit fights.
rotation: Wrath of the Berserker on elites

gear.summary: Fields of Crimson is the key 2H slashing weapon.

builds.name: Blazing Scream Leveling
builds.playstyle: Cone of hellfire screams that melts packs from level 2. Imps soak hits and Demon Skin burns anything that touches you.

gear.summary: Intelligence + Fire damage; any focus with Hellfire cost reduction.

1-15.tip: Take Demon Skin early — the burning barrier both protects you and adds a damage aura while you are still under-geared.

15-70.breakpoint: At 15 you can bind a second Pact — pair the Hellfire Pact with Corruption for Blazing Scream, or with Summons for Minion builds.
tempering: Weapon: Fire damage / Core Skill damage
t1Checklist: Reach level 60+ and finish the Season 15 intro quest (Hell's Legacy)
Imprint your core Legendary Aspect from the Codex of Power
Temper weapon + gloves with the priorities above
Resistances at or above 50% for the common elements
Socket your 3 Soul Splinters into jewelry
Commit to a Prime Evil Path (Splinters of Evil)
Clear Pit Tier 20 or a Waking Nightmare without dying
Complete the Torment I unlock challenge

builds.name: Blazing Scream
builds.playstyle: Brand enemies, curse with Doom, then scream — each burning enemy hit feeds Pyre of Souls stacks for escalating hellfire.

gear.summary: Heir of Perdition for raw damage, Harlequin for Apocalypse uptime.

builds.name: Rampage
builds.playstyle: Transform and rampage through the map — every kill extends the frenzy. Absurd clear speed in Helltides and War Plans.

gear.summary: Movement speed + Hellfire regen; Shroud of False Death.

builds.name: Apocalypse
builds.playstyle: A cooldown loop built around the Ultimate: rain hellfire, then end the world. Best-in-class boss killer of the season.

gear.summary: Max CDR (Harlequin + amulet) to keep Apocalypse looping.

builds.name: Minions
builds.playstyle: A relaxed summoner: imps, a fiend and a gargoyle fight for you. Comfortable but clearly behind the hellfire builds this season.

mechanic.name: Book of the Dead
mechanic.desc: Customise Skeletal Warriors, Skeletal Mages and your Golem — or sacrifice each minion type for a permanent personal bonus.

builds.name: Shred Leveling
builds.playstyle: Werewolf dashes chained with Shred combos. Fast and fun once Shred's third hit unlocks.

1-15.tip: Earthen Bulwark is your panic button — take it at level 6 and its rank-1 barrier keeps you alive through every Act boss.

15-70.breakpoint: Level 15 lets you start bonding Spirit Boons — Wolf bond for Shred/Werenado attack speed, Deer for Rabid Bear survivability.
t1Checklist: Reach level 60+ and finish the Season 15 intro quest (Hell's Legacy)
Imprint your core Legendary Aspect from the Codex of Power
Temper weapon + gloves with the priorities above
Resistances at or above 50% for the common elements
Socket your 3 Soul Splinters into jewelry
Commit to a Prime Evil Path (Splinters of Evil)
Clear Pit Tier 20 or a Waking Nightmare without dying
Complete the Torment I unlock challenge
